# List only retained engine ADRs (including 0004 and 0007) in learn/tree.json

## Context

Sub-issue of `#20498` implementing **Row 3 (`retained-decisions-nav`)** of the three-reader `learn/` map ([`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393)).

- **Ownership disposition:** `unowned-rationale: claimable leaf under #20498 per map #issuecomment-6697670393 (delegated filing by @neo-fable-mnemosyne)`

## The Problem

Under `"Brain Interface, Fleet & Agent Tooling"` → `"Retained Architectural Decisions"` in `learn/tree.json`:
1. Five entries (`0020-privilege-separation-three-plane`, `0032-fleet-manager-process-lifecycle`, `0034-fleet-harness-adapter-contract`, `0037-perspectives-workspace-choreography`, `0038-wake-delivery-dispatch-contract`) are 12-line `"Moved to Agent Institution"` redirect pointer files rather than retained engine ADRs.
2. Meanwhile, two actual engine-retained ADR files that live in `learn/agentos/decisions/` — `0004-session-id-provenance-contract.md` and `0007-agents-md-compaction-taxonomy.md` — are missing from `learn/tree.json`.

Design authority: `#20498` + `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` (Row 3 `retained-decisions-nav`).

## The Architectural Reality

- `learn/agentos/decisions/` holds two classes of files:
  - **Retained Engine ADRs:** `0004`, `0007`, `0008`, `0011`, `0018`, `0025`, `0029` (substantive decision records that govern `neomjs/neo`).
  - **Redirect Pointer Files:** `0020`, `0032`, `0034`, `0037`, `0038` (kept on disk so historical relative links resolve, pointing readers to `neomjs/neo-agent-institution`).
- Listing the 5 redirect pointers as top-level navigation items in `learn/tree.json` wastes the Agent Operator reader's clicks while hiding `0004` and `0007`.

## The Fix

1. In `learn/tree.json` under `"Retained Architectural Decisions"`, remove the 5 redirect pointer entries (`0020`, `0032`, `0034`, `0037`, `0038`) and add the 2 missing retained engine ADRs (`0004-session-id-provenance-contract` and `0007-agents-md-compaction-taxonomy`) in numerical order alongside `0008`, `0011`, `0018`, `0025`, and `0029`.
2. Keep the 5 redirect pointer `.md` files on disk in `learn/agentos/decisions/` so inbound links continue to resolve.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / edge case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `learn/tree.json` (`agentos/decisions` children) | `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` Row 3 | List only substantive retained engine ADRs (`0004`, `0007`, `0008`, `0011`, `0018`, `0025`, `0029`) in `learn/tree.json`; keep redirect `.md` files on disk | `learn/agentos/decisions/README.md` continues to index both retained records and moved pointers | `learn/tree.json` | `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` |

Decision Record impact: `aligned-with` ADR `0004` and ADR `0007` (surfaces them in `learn/tree.json`).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1:** `learn/tree.json` under `"Retained Architectural Decisions"` lists the substantive retained engine ADRs (`0004`, `0007`, `0008`, `0011`, `0018`, `0025`, `0029`) and omits the 5 redirect pointer files (`0020`, `0032`, `0034`, `0037`, `0038`).
- [ ] **AC-2:** The 5 redirect pointer `.md` files remain on disk in `learn/agentos/decisions/`.
- [ ] **AC-3:** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass with `0` errors.

## Out of Scope

Deleting the redirect `.md` files from `learn/agentos/decisions/` or hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` / `apps/portal/llms.txt`.

## Avoided Traps

- Deleting redirect `.md` files on disk (breaks historical relative links).
- Hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt` (`guide-authoring-bar.md` §5).
